_description: RA-1.2B local corpus manifest (example). Copy to local_corpus.json (gitignored) and fill in ABSOLUTE local media paths. NEVER commit local_corpus.json: it contains personal media paths. Case ids are stable, path-free identifiers used in committed benchmark reports.

_schema.case_id: stable identifier, safe to commit in reports
_schema.video: absolute local path to the handcam/gameplay recording
_schema.music: absolute local path to the clean target track
_schema.expected_offset: optional known offset in seconds (production convention: >0 delays music)
_schema.tolerance: optional tolerance in seconds for expected_offset
_schema.notes: free text; must not contain absolute paths when copied into reports

cases.notes: replace with a real local case
video and track are confirmed different songs (different folders, unrelated titles, no filename correspondence)
